evidence.evidence_text: Lexical Semantic Change Detection (SCD) task involves predicting whether a given target word, $w$, changes its meaning between two different text corpora, $C_1$ and $C_2$.
For this purpose, we propose a supervised two-staged SCD method that uses existing Word-in-Context (WiC) datasets.
Experimental results on multiple benchmark datasets for SCD show that our proposed method achieves strong performance in multiple languages.
Additionally, our method achieves significant improvements on WiC benchmarks compared to a sense-aware encoder with conventional distance functions.
